<!-- EDITORS PLEASE TAKE NOTE:

If you are updating the following table due to a change that occurred in the components of the S&P 500 please consider the following.

1. S&P never adds or removes a stock in isolation, it's always "AAA replaced BBB".
 Please do not simply add or remove a component; Rather, make sure you record both parts of the change.

2. If you record a change here, please also make the corresponding changes in the article List of S&P 500 companies. Keeping these two tables in sync should make it much easier for editors to keep track of which changes have/haven't been entered. However, if the announcement of the change has been made but not yet effective, the change can be indicated already in the "Historical components" article but should only be reflected in List of S&P 500 companies once the switch becomes effective in the indicated date.

3. Company name changes and ticker changes are not changes to the index and should not be in this table.
Thanks! -->
[[S&P Dow Jones Indices]] updates the components of the [[S&P 500]] periodically, typically in response to [[mergers and acquisitions]], [[corporate spin-off]]s, or in conjunction with the quarterly rebalancing.<ref name=Methodology>{{cite web | title=S&P U.S. Indices Methodology | url=https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/methodologies/methodology-sp-us-indices.pdf |publisher=[[S&P Global]] |date=June 2026}}</ref> Between January 1, 1963, and December 31, 2014, 1,186 index components were replaced by other components. The following is a list of historical changes to the components of the [[S&P 500]]:
